clientscript.description: CWP ARCH bundle split capture rules on the Sales Order line: keeps the Split flag and its board-foot quantity consistent, and refuses hand edits to Split Status and Split Inventory Adjustment. Those two cannot be made read-only in the field definition because a transactioncolumncustomfield rejects both DISABLED and INLINE, so this script is the only place that intent can live.
clientscript.name: MCGI CS ARCH Split Capture
